offers.name: Lenovo Legion 5 16" WQXGA 240Hz HDR Gaming Laptop - Intel Ultra 9 275HX - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - RTX 5060 - Windows 11 Home - Gray

reviews.quote: It's built well and clean looking, offers solid ergonomics, decent inputs ... the mid-range RTX 5060/5070 options are the ones to look at, as they are priced competitively and can be properly tamed in this chassis.

professional.note: No pro review found for the Legion 5 16 Gen 10 IPS HDR config (honest disclosure per SHARED-legion5-ips.md); inferred from Pro 5 16 Gen 10 (86.8%) and Legion 5 15 chassis (87%).

praises: HDR-labelled 240Hz 16" IPS: brighter HDR highlights than standard IPS (~500-nit class) while staying matte and PWM-free
24-core Ultra 9 275HX + 32GB RAM: workstation-grade multitasking under $3,700 on sale
Only $50 over the non-HDR twin at sale price — the cheap upgrade if you watch HDR video
UltrabookReview: 5060/5070 tiers 'properly tamed in this chassis' — good sustained performance, manageable noise
Full Legion serviceability: dual SODIMM to 64GB, dual M.2, screwed battery, published maintenance manual
complaints: HDR on edge-lit IPS is marketing more than HDR — no local dimming, so highlights bloom; OLED siblings remain far better for HDR
GPU still the mid RTX 5060 despite the big CPU — gamers should price the 5070 configs first
No Thunderbolt on Intel Legion 5 models; no card reader; speakers mediocre (NBC cons)
Legion platform threads: warranty friction and occasional fan-bearing grind / 50-series driver crashes on some units

standouts: HDR-panel upgrade for $50 over the standard twin at sale price
design_philosophy: The HDR-panel variant of the 16" Legion 5 Gen 10: Lenovo's way of offering a brighter, HDR-capable (though still edge-lit IPS) 240Hz panel without pushing buyers up into the OLED Pro tiers. Same CPU-first spec as the 32GB twin — a work-and-play 16" machine at a mainstream sale price.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC Legion Pro 5 16 Gen 10 collection (86.8%) + Legion 5 15 chassis (87%) per SHARED-legion-pro5.md / SHARED-legion5-oled.md, IPS deltas per SHARED-legion5-ips.md.
